title: Foraging Basics
description: Starts with universal foraging rules, dangerous lookalikes, and positive identification, then covers wild greens, berries, nuts, and roots. Includes edible plants for six US regions, mushroom warnings, the Universal Edibility Test and its limits, sustainable and legal foraging, and safe beginner plants.
shortDescription: Safety rules, positive ID, and wild edibles by US region
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
